subtitle: A bug triage note your AI fills from reports.
about: A note with a bug table sorted by severity and space for steps to reproduce each bug. Paste reports into your AI to file them, or edit the rows yourself.

ask.prompt: Set up the bug triage template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: File a bug
slides.you: From support: "I can't pay with my saved Visa. Checkout spins, then says Payment failed. A new card works."
slides.ai: Filed it as P2, since a new card works, with the steps under Details.
slides.alt: Saved Visa fails at checkout, filed as P2

slides.label: Days later, the same bug
slides.you: Another one: "My saved Mastercard won't go through at checkout." Is this already filed?
slides.ai: Yes, as Saved Visa fails at checkout. I added this report to its details.
slides.alt: The Mastercard report added to the bug's details

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.alt: Bug triage as it starts, ready to fill in
